title: Light Carbon LCR018-D unboxing and impressions

takeaways.text: Ordered 14 March, it arrived after 95 days (quoted 45) and only after he accepted an in-stock bar size; he paid US$952 including a second seatpost, spare hangers and a frame bag, against an initial email quote of US$858, plus US$140 shipping.
Weighed: uncut fork 453 g with through-axle, 15 mm-offset seatpost 194 g, inline seatpost 162 g and integrated bar 338 g.
All mounting surfaces were faced, threads smooth and bearings fitted perfectly; internal routing gave no snags.

Design gripes: the saddle-rail bolts are recessed where a torque wrench will not reach, the seat-clamp bolt sits close enough to scratch the post, and the supplied expander plug made the bar hard to fit until he swapped it.
With 105 Di2 and older Elitewheels his build weighs 8.1 kg and cost about £2,040 in total.

disclosure: The owner bought the frameset himself; no sponsorship is stated.
summary: A UK owner's unboxing, weigh-in and build of a matte-black LightCarbon LCR018-D with 105 Di2, including ordering experience.
